observedErrors.message: Tool result declared output without an output schema
observedErrors.cause: The shared result helper introduced by the task-panel pass added Result.output to submit/list tools that declare no Tool.Info.output schema.
The supervising agent paused the current model turn to prevent a potential write followed by rejected receipt. Export shows the tool input was empty when interrupted.

receiptRisk: The same adapter error on a valid submit could reject a receipt after commit. This is distinct from the separately specified lost-response/idempotency feature.

beforeRetryCheck.method: Read-only SQLite query of the existing project task table

repair: Return structured output only for get/query, which declare matching output schemas; preserve direct text-only receipts for submit/list.
regressionCoverage: Exercise real registered submit/list/get adapters; assert submit/list have neither declared schema nor structured result, and get declares a schema with matching structured content. Existing query output/permission coverage retained.
initialChecks: 4 tool tests / 24 assertions pass; native lint and typecheck pass.
desktopResume: Continued the same Architect session through Desktop, requiring existing-task inspection before any new submission. Preserved the user's answered graph, worktree, uncertain recovery, orphan and deterministic audit requirements.
liveRepairVerification: Confirmed in the same Desktop session: lazers_list_tasks and lazers_get_task completed successfully after the receipt repair. Submission then exposed a separate closed-connection failure; no runner row persisted.

connectionRepair.lifecycleRisk: A tool callback retained across plugin reload can outlive the registration-scoped SQLite connection. Concurrent source reloads occurred during the multi-minute model turn; this is consistent with the failure, not proof of every host-internal lifecycle step.
connectionRepair.change: Acquire a new TaskRepository connection after permission assertion for each tool execution, using the captured database path and canonical project. Close it after the synchronous operation. Do not retry a write after an ambiguous error.
connectionRepair.regression: Dispose the registration connection, then invoke the retained submit/get/list/query callbacks. Verify all succeed and exactly one task persists with correct provenance.
connectionRepair.checks: 5 tool tests / 30 assertions; full suite 65 tests / 386 assertions; full native formatter/linter/typechecker pass.
connectionRepair.desktopVerification: Confirmed in the same native Desktop session: one submission completed with taskID 94298112-1c6c-44ba-87f6-a06533eafa59, then lazers_get_task returned revision 1. Exported retrieval exactly matches the read-only SQLite envelope and production TaskSpecSchema. Exactly one row belongs to this session. The native session-scoped Tasks panel displays the submitted task and all 15 criteria.
connectionRepair.storageDecision: WAL and the existing 5000ms busy timeout remain enabled. Share backend domain services between native tools and GUI RPC; a single RPC transport is unnecessary. Future runner writes still require transactional claims, durable command receipts and fencing across local processes. Reopen before operating, rather than replaying a possibly committed write.
